item.title: Postdoc (m/f/d) in infection biology: Salmonella host-pathogen interactions
item.description: The Max Planck Institute for Infection Biology in Berlin invites applications for a postdoctoral researcher to study how Salmonella manipulates macrophages. Experience with bacterial culture, cell culture and microscopy. Application deadline: 31.12.2026
